title: RankedPlaytime
description: The ultimate playtime plugin for your minecraft server!!!
body:
# RankedPlaytime
RankedPlaytime is an advanced playtime plugin for Paper servers.

## Features
- Leaderboard
- Multi-server support: Combined playtime from all servers. (Requires MySQL)
- Total playtime: The playtime of every player combined
- Set playtime (Edit the playtime of a player)
- AFK support: pauses your playtime if you're AFK. (AxAFKZone is automaticly compatibel, for a different plugin you can check it with a placeholder)
- Fully customizable
- Database support (MySQL and SQLite)
- Cool format (#D #H #M #S)
- Lightweigt

## PlaceholderAPI
Single-server:

```
%rankedplaytime_me%
%rankedplaytime_<player>%
%rankedplaytime_total%
%rankedplaytime_leaderboard_place_me%
%rankedplaytime_leaderboard_place_<player>%
%rankedplaytime_leaderboard_place_<number>%
```


Multi-server:

```
%rankedplaytime_me_<server/all-servers>%
%rankedplaytime_<player>_<server/all-servers>%
%rankedplaytime_total_<server/all-servers>%
%rankedplaytime_leaderboard_place_me_<server/all-servers>%
%rankedplaytime_leaderboard_place_<player>_<server/all-servers>%
%rankedplaytime_leaderboard_place_<number>_<server/all-servers>%
```

## Commands

```
/playtime - Show your playtime on the current server
/playtime <server/all-servers> - Show your playtime on a specific scope
/playtime <player> - Show a player's playtime on the current server
/playtime <player> <server/all-servers> - Show a player's playtime on a specific scope
/playtime set <player> <server/all-servers> <playtime> - Set playtime (rankedplaytime.set)
/playtime total <server/all-servers> - Show total playtime
/playtime leaderboard <server/all-servers> <page> - Open leaderboard
/playtime reload - Reload config/messages (rankedplaytime.reload)
/playtime help - Show the helpmessage (rankedplaytime.help)
```
